rules.title: Annual Rent Increase Limit
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are capped at 3% of the current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

coverage.summary: Covered under city rent stabilization ordinance.

rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Protections
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason, such as nonpayment of rent, lease violations, or owner move-in, to evict a tenant.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.

rules.title: Relocation Assistance for No-Fault Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords may be required to pay moving costs if a tenant is evicted for certain reasons.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
